title: Daddy Yankee honoured as Person of the Year at the Latin Grammys
summary: Karol G and Juanes were also among the winners in Las Vegas.
body:
Daddy Yankee was honoured as the Latin Recording Academy's Person of the Year at this week's 27th Latin Grammy Awards in Las Vegas.

The Puerto Rican star, best known around the world for "Gasolina" and "Despacito", is one of the most influential figures in reggaeton.

Other winners

  • Karol G won Best Urban Music Album for Tropicoqueta.
  • Juanes won Best Pop/Rock Album.
  • Aria Vega was named Best New Artist.

The night's biggest prize, Album of the Year, went to Spain's Rosalía for Lux.

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter, Billboard, Deadline.
